environment.description: Same Node.js 18 Apollo GraphQL service on EKS 1.28. Pod runs in namespace 'api-services'. A Cilium-based NetworkPolicy with L3/L4 egress rules is applied: the policy spec uses a CiliumNetworkPolicy CRD with egressDeny rules matching CIDR 169.254.169.254/32 on all ports, combined with a default-allow for other egress (so DNS, external APIs still work). The policy is labeled with app=graphql-config-svc and enforced by Cilium agent v1.14 in strict mode. Additionally, the EKS node group has IMDSv2 enforced (HttpTokens: required, HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 1) which means even if a connection were established, the lack of a PUT-obtained token would cause 401 from IMDS. Pod uses a projected service account token with audience-bound IRSA, not instance profile credentials.

config.pod_identity: IRSA with projected service account token (sts.amazonaws.com audience)
